notes.title: Patch 1.1: The Locomotion Update!
notes.notes:
We here at Sunset Division couldn't be happier with how much y'all are liking The Rig! We've heard some feedback regarding our default teleport locomotion and some performance issues and have been working hard to address it. 

With that said, we're happy to announce our first major patch. Check out the notes below!

[b][h2]Locomotion Options[/h2][/b]
By far the biggest thing you have requested is locomotion options, so here you go!

[list]
[*] Choose between Teleport and Smooth Locomotion (with 2 different speed settings)
[*] Choose between Snap Turn, Smooth Turn, or No Turning
[*] Choose which hand controls movement vs. turning
[/list]


[b][h2]Quality/Performance Options[/h2][/b]
We know that for many of you, frame rate is SUPER important. That's why we've added some basic performance options that you can tweak. 

[list]
[*] Overall quality options
[*] Toggle HBAO (Horizon Based Ambient Occlusion): NOTE: If you're having performance issues, disabling this option should give you a big improvement
[/list]


Thank you all for your feedback and for playing our little game. Please keep it coming!

Love,
Sunset Division

notes.title: The Rig: A Starmap to Murder is Now Available!
notes.notes:
We here at Sunset Division are so excited to announce that THE RIG: A STARMAP TO MURDER is now available for download! Thanks so much to all of you who have shown interest in the game, we really can't wait for you to play it.

notes.title: Official Release Date Announcement
notes.notes:
Well, it's been a long time coming, but our debut game is coming out in less than a month. We're a small, scrappy team working on The Rig in our spare time, and we couldn't be more excited to share it with you all!

For anyone who's followed us for a while, we ARE still alive. Progress is always slower when you've got pesky things like "work" and "children" to deal with, but we're happy to say that The Rig is finally done (barring those fun little surprise bugs).

If you're even a little bit excited to play The Rig and know someone else who might like it, we would really appreciate you spreading the word. We don't have a full-time marketing team (okay, we don't have a marketing team at all), so any word-of-mouth is really awesome! 

[b]You can find us on social media here:[/b]

[url=http://twitter.com/TheRigVR]http://twitter.com/TheRigVR[/url]

[url=https://www.instagram.com/sunsetdivisiongames/]https://www.instagram.com/sunsetdivisiongames/[/url]


[b]Check out the launch trailer here![/b]

[previewyoutube=fUWwHtFXSyM;full][/previewyoutube]


If you have any questions, please feel free to post in the forums. We will be responding as quickly as we can. Can't wait for you all to experience The Rig!
